name: Demo Partner Restaurant
shortDescription: A complete sample listing showing how a participating restaurant and its member-exclusive benefit will appear in the directory.
fullDescription: This is a demonstration partner created for preview and testing. Replace the establishment name, images, links, contact details, branches, offer mechanics, and promo code with confirmed information before the official public launch.
offerDetails: Active FICCI members receive 10% off their total bill for eligible dine-in, takeout, and online orders. Members must present their active membership in the My Glue app before payment. For online orders, enter the promo code at checkout.
branches: Online orders — Nationwide delivery subject to service coverage
terms: Demo entry only; confirm all information with the establishment before public launch.
Available to active FICCI members who present their membership through the My Glue app.
For physical redemption, the benefit must be requested before billing or payment.
For online redemption, use promo code FICCI10 before completing checkout.
Valid for eligible regular-priced items only.
Not valid with other promotions, senior citizen discounts, PWD discounts, gift certificates, or special packages.
A minimum purchase of ₱1,000 applies to online orders.
The establishment may request a valid ID matching the member record.
Offer is subject to participating branch availability and confirmed program rules.
